## Names and quoting (ADR 0018)

Accepted — capitalized names mid-sentence, quoted identifiers, multi-word names:

```
✓ the tool Lexgen builds the Lexicon
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 40%
✓ the database WordNet attests the senses of the words
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 3, depth 1, right-branching 38%
✓ the file "seed.json" is the source of the truth
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 4, depth 1, right-branching 25%
✓ "seed.json" is the source of the truth
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 3, depth 1, right-branching 17%
✓ the tool Visual Studio Code opens the file
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 40%
```

Multi-word quoted spans — the current limitation, shown explicitly:
a quoted span of ANY length is ONE opaque thing (an identifier-like
NP), even if it contains a whole sentence. The quoted content is NOT
validated as minglish — quotation-as-mention is a separate, undesigned
construction (see docs/ideas.md, "Quotation as a construction").

```
✓ the agent stores "delete the file" in the database
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 4, depth 1, right-branching 33%
✓ "the old build process" is a report
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 3, depth 1, right-branching 0%
✓ the agent stores "this is not valid minglish at all !!" in the database
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 4, depth 1, right-branching 33%
```

Rejected — the fail-loud rules (typos never silently become names):

```
✗ Discard the file
  WORD: "Discard" is not a minglish word — a name cannot start a sentence — introduce it ("the tool Lexgen …") or quote it; or if this is a command, use a minglish verb in lowercase ("delete the file")
✓ Lexgen builds the Lexicon
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 33%
✗ the agent reads the File
  WORD: "File" is not a minglish word — minglish words are lowercase ("file"); a name that equals a word needs quotes
```

## The repair loop: word-level flags and their fixes

Each Rejection followed by the sentence an agent writes after applying
the advice:

```
✗ it fails
  WORD: "it" is banned in minglish — third-person reference is banned - repeat the noun you mean (ADR 0002)
✓ the test fails
  parses uniquely — peak-open 1, max-dep 1, depth 1, right-branching 0%

✗ the agent may fail
  WORD: "may" is banned in minglish — for permission write "can"; for possibility rephrase the sentence (ADR 0009)
✓ the agent can fail
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 0%

✗ please delete the file
  WORD: "please" is banned in minglish — politeness markers are not minglish - state the instruction directly or write "you must ..."
✓ delete the file
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 50%

✗ the agent deleted three files
  WORD: "three" is banned in minglish — counts are digits: write "3 files", not "three files" (ADR 0022)
✓ the agent deleted 3 files
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 25%

✗ the agent deleted 1 file
  WORD: "1" is not a minglish word — write "one" — exactly one stays a word (ADR 0016)
✓ the agent deleted one file
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 25%

✗ 0 agents retry the request
  STYLE:
    - "0" is a value, not a count — for none write "no <noun> …" as the subject, or "… does not <verb> <nouns>" (ADR 0022)
✓ no agent retries the request
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 25%

✗ the agent deleted 0 files
  STYLE:
    - "0" is a value, not a count — for none write "no <noun> …" as the subject, or "… does not <verb> <nouns>" (ADR 0022)
✓ the agent did not delete files
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 3, depth 1, right-branching 20%

✗ the same file fails
  WORD: "same" is banned in minglish — "same" has two meanings - for that very thing, repeat the noun with "the" ("the file", not "the same file"); for two things that match, write "identical" ("the copies are identical") (ADR 0023)
✓ the file fails
  parses uniquely — peak-open 1, max-dep 1, depth 1, right-branching 0%

✗ the copies are the same
  WORD: "same" is banned in minglish — "same" has two meanings - for that very thing, repeat the noun with "the" ("the file", not "the same file"); for two things that match, write "identical" ("the copies are identical") (ADR 0023)
✓ the copies are identical
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 0%
```

## The repair loop: STYLE flags and their fixes

```
✗ every agent does not retry the request
  STYLE:
    - "every … not" is scope-ambiguous — for none write "no <noun> …"; for not-all write "some <nouns> do not …" (ADR 0014)
✓ no agent retries the request
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 25%
✓ some agents do not retry the request
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 3, depth 1, right-branching 17%

✗ no agent must check the input
  STYLE:
    - "no … must" is ambiguous — for prohibition write, for example, "agents must not check the input" (bare plural + must not, ADR 0014)
✓ agents must not check the input
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 3, depth 1, right-branching 20%

✗ the agent retries no request
  STYLE:
    - "no" is subject-only — write "… does not <verb> <nouns>" instead (ADR 0014)
✓ the agent does not retry requests
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 3, depth 1, right-branching 20%

✗ some agent retries the request
  STYLE:
    - "some" takes a plural noun (ADR 0017)
✓ some agents retry the request
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 25%

✗ if the test fails, the agent retries the request
  STYLE:
    - conditional without "then" — write: if <clause>, then <clause> (ADR 0007)
✓ if the test fails, then the agent retries the request
  parses uniquely — peak-open 5, max-dep 8, depth 2, right-branching 10%

✗ the agent retries the request if the test fails
  STYLE:
    - "request if" — a word mentioned as a word must be quoted: "request \"if\"" (ADR 0018)
    - condition must come first — write: if <clause>, then <clause> (ADR 0007)
✓ if the test fails, then the agent retries the request
  parses uniquely — peak-open 5, max-dep 8, depth 2, right-branching 10%

✗ the agent is opening the file
  STYLE:
    - progressive ("is <verb>-ing") is not in minglish — use the simple form (ADR 0003)
✓ the agent opens the file
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 25%

✗ the agent has deleted the file
  STYLE:
    - perfect aspect ("has <verb>-ed") is not in minglish — use the simple past (ADR 0016)
✓ the agent deleted the file
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 25%

✗ the file stored in the database fails
  STYLE:
    - "stored" is transitive in minglish and needs an object
    - this reads as a reduced relative ("the file stored …") — minglish has no relative clauses yet; split into two sentences (ADR 0010)
✓ the agent stored the file in the database
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 5, depth 1, right-branching 29%
✓ the file fails
  parses uniquely — peak-open 1, max-dep 1, depth 1, right-branching 0%

✗ a files are big
  STYLE:
    - "a files" — a/an take a singular noun
✓ the files are big
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 0%

✗ the agent deleted 3 file
  STYLE:
    - "3 file" — a number takes a plural noun (ADR 0022)
✓ the agent deleted 3 files
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 25%

✗ the test fails so the agent retries the request
  STYLE:
    - a comma before "so" is mandatory — "<clause>, so <clause>" (ADR 0026)
✓ the test fails, so the agent retries the request
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 3, depth 2, right-branching 22%

✗ because the test fails, the agent retries the request
  STYLE:
    - "because" cannot start a sentence — write the result first: "<result>, because <reason>"; or cause first: "<cause>, so <result>" (ADR 0026)
    - a comma cannot join 2 clauses — write 2 sentences, or "<clause>, so <clause>" / "<clause>, because <clause>" (ADR 0026)
✓ the agent retries the request, because the test fails
  parses uniquely — peak-open 3, max-dep 4, depth 2, right-branching 22%

✗ the Seed grows. therefore the expense grows
  WORD: "therefore" is banned in minglish — for a cause and its result write "<cause>, so <result>"; for a result and its reason write "<result>, because <reason>" (ADR 0026)
✓ the Seed grows, so the expense grows
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 3, depth 2, right-branching 14%

✗ the agent stopped
  STYLE:
    - "stopped" is transitive in minglish and needs an object
✓ the agent stopped the process
  parses uniquely — peak-open 2, max-dep 2, depth 1, right-branching 25%
```
